# NFL Week 7 - Sun Oct 25

Edge factor 0.58 applied (raw edge over 50% x 0.58).

## Pick
- **Bengals -2.5 at Ravens (-117), 0.5u.** Lamar Jackson downgraded to OUT; line flipped Ravens -3 -> Bengals -2.5. Dimers model (updated after the news) 59.3%; Covers AI had Baltimore by only 1 *with* Lamar expected; Covers expert on Bengals ML; Bengals off a bye with a clean injury report. Fading a backup-QB team (our backup-QB dogs are 0-3). Raw ~58% -> 54.6% vs 53.9% implied. Small stake because we are buying after a 5.5-point move (CLV has been poor).

## Leans (no bet)
1. Lions -3 vs Packers - Covers AI 27-22, sharp money on Lions -3, Mays and Branch back. No second independent model.
2. Panthers -2.5/-3 vs Bucs - Covers AI 24-20; Mayfield playing with a protected thumb, Egbuka and Goedeke out. Only at -2.5.
3. Steelers -3 vs Saints (Paris) - Covers AI 24-20; but Saints have 65% of handle.
4. 49ers -2.5 at Falcons - Dimers 54.6% and Covers AI 27-20 agree, but line fell 4.5 -> 2.5 on sharp Falcons money with 82% of tickets on SF. Pass.

## Passes
Texans/Giants (sharps vs Covers AI disagree), Rams/Raiders (Puka injury, sharps on LV), Chiefs/Seahawks (Dimers 50/50), Broncos/Cardinals, Dolphins/Jets, Browns/Titans, Colts/Vikings, all totals (1-3). MNF Cowboys/Eagles: Eagles +4.5 with Tanner McKee for Hurts is a backup-QB dog - pass.
